meta.source: Derived from Sefaria-Project static/css (color-palette.css, fonts.css), with Sefaria Labs extensions; Social Daylight updated to match sefaria-social #39 (spec 060)

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page background. Night is the hero theme for Labs channels and anything AI; Parchment is Labs' light theme for reading and print; Daylight is Sefaria Social's own light theme: white paper (since the first review of sefaria-social #39).

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Cards, the room sidebar, margin notes, popovers.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Wells, code and transcript panels, the video tray.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines and dividers. Decorative only, never the only boundary of a control.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Control borders (inputs, quiet buttons). At least 3:1 on surface in both themes.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text on surface, surface-raised and surface-sunken (≥13:1 in both themes).

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text and metadata on surface and surface-raised (≥6:1 in both themes).

tokens.name: sefaria-blue
tokens.usage: Sefaria's brand blue, unchanged. A fill on Parchment; on Night use sefaria-blue-lit for large fields, never as text.

tokens.name: sefaria-blue-lit
tokens.usage: Large brand fields (cover blocks, banners). Sefaria Blue lifted so it holds on Night.

tokens.name: brand
tokens.usage: Links, primary actions, selected states. Text-safe on surface (≥7:1 both themes).

tokens.name: on-brand
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a brand fill.

tokens.name: live
tokens.usage: LIVE ONLY: a room that is live now, presence, the live dot, the cursor you follow. Lit from Sefaria's Tannaitic green #00827F. Text-safe on surface (≥4.6:1).

tokens.name: on-live
tokens.usage: Text on a live fill (LIVE badge, Join button).

tokens.name: live-soft
tokens.usage: Live tint behind the text another learner is on.

tokens.name: spark
tokens.usage: AI ONLY: anything Claude or another model wrote or suggested. Sefaria purple #7C416F (the Library Assistant's color) lit up. Text-safe on surface (≥6:1).

tokens.name: on-spark
tokens.usage: Text on a spark fill.

tokens.name: spark-soft
tokens.usage: Background of an AI note or AI summary block.

tokens.name: gold
tokens.usage: Warmth: margin notes, the second cursor, the unread count, the active tab, a given Yasher koach. From Sefaria's Talmud gold #CCB479. Text-safe on surface (≥4.9:1).

tokens.name: highlight
tokens.usage: Highlight behind selected or annotated text, the Question label and margin notes. In Daylight it is a sunny gold: Social's main warm accent. Ink stays readable on it.

tokens.name: sun
tokens.usage: The primary action: a gold pill with on-sun text (Social's main button, the reader's Sign Up). One per view. Never text.

tokens.name: on-sun
tokens.usage: Text on a sun fill.

tokens.name: cursor-gold
tokens.usage: A learner's cursor colour in Social: the ring of their avatar (white fill, ink initials), the same colour for the same person every time. Ring at 3:1 or more on white. Never teal or violet, which are signals; never body text.

tokens.name: cursor-blue
tokens.usage: A learner's cursor colour in Social: the ring of their avatar (white fill, ink initials), the same colour for the same person every time. Ring at 3:1 or more on white. Never teal or violet, which are signals; never body text.

tokens.name: cursor-sky
tokens.usage: A learner's cursor colour in Social: the ring of their avatar (white fill, ink initials), the same colour for the same person every time. Ring at 3:1 or more on white. Never teal or violet, which are signals; never body text.

tokens.name: cursor-coral
tokens.usage: A learner's cursor colour in Social: the ring of their avatar (white fill, ink initials), the same colour for the same person every time. Ring at 3:1 or more on white. Never teal or violet, which are signals; never body text.

tokens.name: cursor-moss
tokens.usage: A learner's cursor colour in Social: the ring of their avatar (white fill, ink initials), the same colour for the same person every time. Ring at 3:1 or more on white. Never teal or violet, which are signals; never body text.

tokens.name: cursor-rose
tokens.usage: A learner's cursor colour in Social: the ring of their avatar (white fill, ink initials), the same colour for the same person every time. Ring at 3:1 or more on white. Never teal or violet, which are signals; never body text.

tokens.name: presence-tanakh
tokens.usage: Presence color 1 (from tanakh-teal): a learner's avatar ring, cursor and highlight.

tokens.name: presence-mishnah
tokens.usage: Presence color 2 (from mishnah-blue).

tokens.name: presence-talmud
tokens.usage: Presence color 3 (from talmud-gold).

tokens.name: presence-midrash
tokens.usage: Presence color 4 (from midrash-green).

tokens.name: presence-liturgy
tokens.usage: Presence color 5 (from liturgy-rose).

tokens.name: presence-reference
tokens.usage: Presence color 6 (from responsa/reference). In Daylight the presence colors are deepened category colors used as avatar backgrounds with white initials (≥4.5:1). Never body text.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus: 2px ring with a 2px surface-colored gap.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Errors and destructive actions only (from responsa-red).

families.hebrew: "Taamey Frank", "Frank Ruhl Libre", "Times New Roman", serif

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: Channel art and hero lines. One per surface.

styles.name: display-l
styles.usage: Podcast and newsletter titles, X banner line.

styles.name: heading
styles.sample: Why the library needs a beit midrash

styles.name: quote
styles.sample: The goal isn't the chidush. It's a really good hava amina.

styles.name: reading
styles.sample: Judah has dealt treacherously, and an abomination is committed in Israel.
styles.usage: English source text and long-form newsletter body.

styles.name: ui
styles.sample: Zohar wrote a margin note on 2:11

styles.name: ref
styles.usage: Ref tags, live counts, timestamps. Uppercase. The machine layer: anything the system reports, not anything a person wrote.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Badges and eyebrows (LIVE, AI SUMMARY, EP 01).

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap, presence dot offset.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Tight stacks, badge padding.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Button padding, list gaps.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding, gutters.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Text line pitch in channel art; section gaps.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Margins of channel art.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Hero padding.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Large layout gaps, banner insets.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Badges, ref tags, the caret ends.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Sefaria's standard radius: buttons, inputs, cards.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: The logo page, panels, channel art blocks.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Presence avatars, the live dot, pill buttons.
